_doc: Mission Gorge Rd's raised median (Lake Murray piece C) over its whole MD13 / MD13b run: the island's faces per station off the USGS 2024 lidar (mg_median_faces_g10.py --full; the method is its docstring, the same as mg_median_faces.lidar.g10.json's). Stations are rows of `columns` (decl_* = the plan before item 1b, now_* = the data now; *_outer_* = the road's outer curb faces on the +-22 m section; lane_room = outer face to island face; road_middle = the mean of the two outer faces). Piece frame: metres off piece C's line, + = left of J3 -> J4 travel = north-west. left_m / right_m = the two faces, width_m = left - right, middle_m = their mean; *_unc_m = half the interval between the neighbouring points the face lies between (point spacing); steps = top - road at each face; top_over_road_m = the top's median minus the mean of the two road lines at the faces. declared = the plan before ledger 0099 item 1b (mg_median_correction.json rows[0] over s 982.5-1212.5, the data's rows elsewhere); pc_fit = the rows the PC set there (the data now); photo_raw = faces_md.py's station (before +0.30 / +0.49); photo_gaps = gaps_md.py's terracotta strip (salmon_middle_m turned into this frame).

frame.projection: shrub_heights.Track.to_local: pyproj EPSG 6340 -> 4326 ('Inverse of UTM zone 11N + NAD83(2011) to WGS 84 (1) (with axis order normalized for visualization)', stated accuracy 2.0 m), then the WGS84 metres-per-degree series at the origin

rings_side_a_left.what: MD11 / MD13 / MD13b rings: side A (the first half of polygon_xz) at median_off_m + w / 2, side B at - w / 2, in this frame (noses left out)

road_at_line_minus_y3dep_m.what: the lidar road (set A within 0.5 m of the line) minus the plan's y_3dep, engine y

summary.what: piece C s 225.0-2245.0, every 2.5 m: per 50 m bin the lidar island against the declared band, and the flags

flags._doc: openings = runs of 'none' stations (the island ends between last_island_before_s and the run, and starts again between the run and first_island_after_s); declared_gaps = runs of stations where the declared band has no island (data_now_gaps: the band in the data now); width_changes / middle_shifts = stretches where the running median (island stations within +-5 m [invented]) changes by more than 0.3 m over 10 m [invented], with the values 5 m either side; bin_width_steps = consecutive 50 m bins whose median widths differ by more than 0.3 m; bins_off_declared = bins where the median lidar - declared width or middle passes 0.3 m; unclear_runs = 3+ unclear stations running
